test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Mothers, Females, Sisters

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08cbd5b30537ba5f45e3d7eb4c50f7db5db302c140c23834130dd6c3e1282ad9.png]
solution:
According to the given information, 

The classes are given as,

Mothers, Females, Sisters.

Now option A is given as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92924a036bd40e4e270f82ca0edd769663e1c7ff43f7babb7f2fa904504775fd.png] 

Here, Sisters has no intersection with Mothers. Thus, this option is incorrect.

Now option B is given as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5091fb0812849c80e55c7a0ef17f0b4efa5c73769939fe74162faae6f7de4075.png] 

Here, sisters are shown to be a complete subset of Mothers but that is incorrect since not all sisters are mothers. Thus, this option is incorrect.

Now option C is given as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee82d201a41e89e54f6e3849e1e8aa984e915efd19558192684f0db86e6546c9.png] 

Here, Sisters have an intersection with Mothers, and both classes are subclass of Females. Thus, this option is correct.

Now option D is given as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10b9da020eb67328761bd5f53cfd1c9e9d2a6343fdb721e02d9049acd68fa985.png] 

Here, Sisters and Mothers are intersections of the class of Females but not a subclass of it. Thus, this option is incorrect.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3)**.
